title: Capstio pricing
intro: Two plans, priced in US dollars: Personal at ${personal} a year and Team at ${team} per person per month. Both start with a {days}-day free trial with every feature unlocked.

includes.title: What every plan includes
includes.intro: Everything in Personal is part of Team too. Team adds what a group needs to work together: the end-to-end encrypted vault, roles, a shared audit log and shared recipes.
includes.trial: A {days}-day free trial with every feature unlocked

items.question: How long is the free trial?
items.answer: {days} days, with every feature unlocked. Both Personal and Team start with it.

items.question: What happens when the trial ends?
items.answer: To keep using Capstio, pick a plan: Personal at ${personal} a year, or Team at ${team} per person per month.

items.question: Can I use Capstio for commercial work?
items.answer: Yes. Commercial use is part of the Personal plan, and Team includes everything in Personal.

items.question: Should I pick Personal or Team?
items.answer: Personal is one year of use for one person on their own Mac. Team is for groups that share servers, SSH keys and recipes: it adds the end-to-end encrypted team vault, the Owner, Admin, Operator and Viewer roles, a shared audit log you can export to CSV, Slack and webhook alerts, and recipes shared over Git.

items.question: Is there a limit on hosts?
items.answer: No. Every plan includes unlimited hosts.

items.question: How does Team pricing work?
items.answer: ${team} for each person on the team, per month. Prices are in US dollars.
